Why spend billions of resources building a complex GregTech fusion reactor when there is already a massive, uncontained, perfectly functioning one hanging right above your head in the sky? The Energy Collector MK1 is your first foray into tapping the limitless power of the Sun. By capturing ambient stellar radiation and condensing it into raw Energy-Matter Covalence (EMC), you have created a machine that generates matter from literal thin air.

Functionally, this entry-level collector generates a modest §l4 EMC§r per second and has a maximum internal buffer of 10,000 EMC. While it won't be carrying your entire economy just yet (hey, it is better than nothing!), it possesses a highly useful secondary feature: it can automatically upgrade alchemical fuels placed in its internal slots (similar to the inner ring of a Transmutation Table) in a strict, sequential order. §lFree fuel is free fuel!§r
